findings.title: The AUX allowance (and the U401 GAP-3 estimate) treats U401 alone in 70 C air: the 1.1 C margin is smaller than the unmodelled heating from U400 / L400 and the rest of the board; U400 has no junction estimate at all

evidence.file: m3_design/r10_parts.py power_budget(); sources/r10_design/parts_budget.json; R10_DECISIONS D-R19-14 "AUX allowance"
evidence.maker: TPS7A91 SBVS282A p4: RthetaJA 62.5 C/W (DSK, JEDEC board, self-heating only), TJ recommended max 125 C; p6 Tsd 160 C (reset 140 C). AP63201 DS41326 Rev 3-2 p4: thetaJA 89 C/W (TSOT26, single-layer board); p5 RDS(on) 125 / 68 mohm; p12 "should not exceed +125 C".
evidence.geometry: U401 B(27.6,13.6); L400 F(24.2,5.55), 8.7 mm away; U400 F(16.9,5.55), 13.3 mm away; all three share the In1 GND plane (3724 mm^2) that is U401s only heat path (two VIPPO vias).
evidence.neighbour_power: Same allocation case (camera 1 A + ports 0.561 A from U400): U400 + L400 loss 1.18 W at 88 % / 1.48 W at 85 % / 2.16 W at 80 % (the budget itself uses 80-85 %); unshed logic + SD writes 1.38-2.23 W at the converter input, almost all dissipated on the board. Board total about 3-5 W (Calculation from the budget allocations).
evidence.board_rise: 46 x 90 mm, both faces 8280 mm^2; with h 8-12 W/m^2K (still bay air, convection plus radiation, Inference) the board-to-air resistance is 10-15 C/W, so the mean board rise is about 30-75 C above bay air in that case (Inference). U401 sees some fraction of this on top of its own theta-JA term; any fraction above 1.1 C breaks the 125 C floor at 110 C/W.
evidence.u400: No U400 junction estimate exists (grep of M3_R10, R10_VALIDATION, parts_qualification). At 1.561 A, 7.4 V: conduction about 0.38 W hot (x1.4) + switching about 0.07 W = 0.46 W, rise about 41 C at 89 C/W; at the 1.811 A camera-at-limit case about 0.60 W, rise about 54 C, before neighbour heating (Calculation / Inference).

findings.impact: The 100 mA AUX allowance is presented as derived from the GAP-3 floor, but the floor is met only if U401 is the sole heat source on the board. With the camera on in a hot bay, U401 (and U400) can run above 125 C; at Tsd (160 / 140 C) U401 cycles and GPS, radio and AUX drop together (tracking / telemetry loss, not a pyro hazard). The real port draw is probably far below the allocation (radio 200 mA average by MicoAir), which is why this is Minor.
findings.concrete_fix: No CAD change. (1) State the port limit as the total PORT_4V8 current (GPS + radio + AUX <= 0.56 A, any split) rather than a per-port 100 mA, since the thermal term depends only on the total. (2) Label the 109.2-123.9 C figure "U401 self-heating only" and add a coupled-board term (or a U400 estimate) in parts_budget, or say plainly that no thermal margin is claimed. (3) Make the AUX allowance conditional on the first-article power-knot measurement: thermocouples on U401, U400 and L400 at the allocation loads (camera 1 A dummy, 0.56 A on PORT_4V8, SD writing) at 70 C chamber air, steady state; pass if the U401 / U400 case temperatures imply TJ <= 125 C.

findings.title: U401s regulation tap R402.1 hangs on the first OUT via only; if that via opens, the doubled feed keeps power on but the LDO runs open loop and PORT_4V8 rises to about PORT_5V3 (5.37-5.55 V) on all three ports

evidence.copper: R402.1 (PORT_4V8, FB top 49.9 k) F(30.575,12.6) joins PORT_4V8 only through F.Cu (29.75,12.6)->(30.575,12.6), w 0.4, to via (29.75,12.6). No other F.Cu PORT_4V8 copper reaches it; GPS_RX_MCU F.Cu (28.8,11.0)->(32.0,11.0) blocks a direct F.Cu link to the new (30.5,9.95) via.
evidence.seeded: Copy with via (29.75,12.6) removed, kicad-cli 10.0.7 DRC: 1 unconnected item, R402.1 F.Cu stub versus the U401.1 B.Cu run. Removing (29.75,9.95) alone: 0 unconnected (power redundancy confirmed). DC solve U401 -> J410 / J420: via (29.75,12.6) carries 0.25 A of 0.3 A, (29.75,9.95) 0.05 A.
evidence.behaviour: With R402.1 open, FB is pulled to GND by R403 10 k (TPS7A91 IFB <= 100 nA, SBVS282A p5), so the pass device saturates: PORT_4V8 = PORT_5V3 minus dropout (< 200 mV at 1 A, p5), about 5.2-5.55 V over the buck band 5.37-5.546 V (parts_budget buck_V).
evidence.module_limits: Project records: MicoAir LR900 4.5-5 V, HGLRC M100 Mini 3.3-5 V (r10_plan O5; parts_qualification R8-MCU-02). An unregulated 5.2-5.55 V exceeds both stated maxima.

findings.impact: The D-R19-09 second via turns an open (29.75,12.6) from "all three ports dead" into "all three ports over-voltage", which is silent on the bench unless PORT_4V8 is measured. A manufacturing-defect path (one open via), Minor.
findings.concrete_fix: Now (docs): add a first-article and pre-flight check: PORT_4V8 at J410.1 / J420.1 / J440.1 to GND reads 4.71-4.87 V on pack power (ORDERING 8.3), which screens both U401 OUT vias and the sense tap. At the next board change: give R402.1 its own PORT_4V8 tap that does not depend on the (29.75,12.6) barrel, e.g. move R402 so pad 1 lands on the F.Cu run near (30.5,9.95), or reroute GPS_RX_MCU so a 0.2 mm F.Cu link (30.5,9.95)->(30.575,12.6) fits.

findings.title: Two documents say the ports are off during hold-up because U11 blocks reverse current; the TPS2121 lets up to 0.2-2 A back-feed before it blocks, and the budget (correctly) assumes C84 does carry the ports

evidence.statements: docs/M3_R10.md line 323-324 ("They are off ... during the hold-up interval after the switch opens, because TPS2121 U11 blocks reverse current into RAW_PROTECTED"); docs/R10_VALIDATION.md line 1924 ("during hold-up after the switch opens, PORT_4V8 is off while the MCU runs (U11 blocks reverse current)").
evidence.contrary: parts_budget.json battery_break_ride_through_note: "No credit for RAW_PROTECTED capacitance or U11 reverse blocking"; r10_parts.py comment: "C84 on VLOGIC back-feeds RAW_PROTECTED through U11 (TPS2121 reverse blocking only above IRCB 0.2 / 1 / 2 A)"; parts_qualification.md line 762. The 0.464-0.539 ms ports-on hold-up figure exists only because the ports are assumed to stay on.
evidence.maker: TPS2121 SLVSEA3F p8: IRCB fast reverse current detection 0.2 / 1 / 2 A (VOUT > VINx), tRCB 10 us; section 9.3.6. The ports-on reverse demand is about 11.2-13.1 W / 6-7 V = 1.6-2.2 A, inside the detection spread.

findings.impact: Firmware and bench readers get two contradictory models of the same interval: the TX-parking rule (R18-m07, R19-MCU-01) and the hold-up time both depend on whether PORT_4V8 is live then. Documentation defect only; the conservative number is the one used.
findings.concrete_fix: Reword both lines: "On USB-only power the ports are off (U11s IN2 channel is off). After the switch opens, C84 may back-feed RAW_PROTECTED through U11 until the reverse current exceeds IRCB (0.2-2 A), so the ports may stay powered for part or all of the hold-up; the budget assumes they do."
